# Icon source

The glyph paths in `components/AliIcon.tsx` were downloaded on 2026-08-01
from Alibaba Iconfont's **Ant Design official icon collection** (collection
ID 9402):

https://www.iconfont.cn/collections/detail?cid=9402

`ICONFONT_SOURCE_IDS` records the upstream Iconfont ID for every bundled
glyph. Geometry is kept as the SVG path returned by Iconfont; the local React
wrapper only controls color, sizing, and accessibility attributes.

The upstream Ant Design project is distributed under the MIT License. A copy
is included in this directory.
